learningPreferences.goal: Career-focused DevOps upskilling with practical repo-first exercises

successCriteria: Understand and explain CI/CD flow in this repository
Build and run API/worker containers confidently
Deploy staging on AWS with automated pipeline
Operate logging, alarms, and rollback safely
Promote tested artifacts from staging to production
Translate AWS architecture patterns to Azure and GCP equivalents

sessionTemplate: 10-15 min theory: one concept and why it matters
25-35 min hands-on: one repo task or cloud operation
5-10 min reflection: what failed, why, and fix notes
learningModel.rule: Every theory block must end with one practical validation step.

architectureDecision.recommendedBaseline: AWS ECS Fargate + ECR + ALB + CloudWatch + Secrets Manager + SES + SNS/Twilio
architectureDecision.why: Professional, scalable, lower operational overhead and lower entry complexity than raw EC2
architectureDecision.budgetApproach: Staging-first, small task sizes, minimal managed resources, strict log retention

emailAndSms.gcp: Third-party providers (e.g., Twilio/SendGrid) with GCP runtime

crossCloudLearningMilestones.title: Service Equivalence Mastery
tasks: Map each AWS service in your design to Azure and GCP equivalents
Document trade-offs: cost, complexity, and ecosystem maturity
Explain when you would choose each cloud

crossCloudLearningMilestones.title: Portable Deployment Mindset
tasks: Keep Docker images and app config cloud-agnostic
Use Terraform patterns that can be adapted across providers
Avoid tight provider lock-in unless there is a clear business reason

milestones.title: CI/CD Foundations
milestones.outcome: Read and explain current CI workflow and job dependencies

tasks.title: Explain workflow triggers and branch strategy
Map lint -> test -> build -> typecheck dependencies
Explain why Nx affected improves CI speed

milestones.title: Container Fundamentals
milestones.outcome: Run reproducible API and worker containers with health checks

tasks.title: Understand Docker image layers and multi-stage builds
Build production-style API and worker images locally
Validate startup/shutdown behavior and health endpoints

milestones.title: AWS Core Services
milestones.outcome: Understand and operate ECS/Fargate deployment path

tasks.title: Learn ECR image lifecycle and tagging strategy
Understand ECS service, task definition, and ALB routing
Read logs in CloudWatch and verify health checks

milestones.title: Infrastructure as Code
milestones.outcome: Deploy staging stack via Terraform safely

tasks.title: Learn terraform init/plan/apply workflow
Create environment isolation for staging and production
Review and explain plan diffs before apply

milestones.title: Automated Staging CD
milestones.outcome: Auto-deploy staging from develop after successful CI

tasks.title: Build and push immutable images to ECR in GitHub Actions
Deploy API and worker services to staging ECS
Run smoke checks and define rollback process

milestones.title: Observability and Reliability
milestones.outcome: Detect and respond to operational failures quickly

tasks.title: Standardize structured logs across API and worker
Create CloudWatch alarms for 5xx, worker down, queue failures
Build a simple operations dashboard
Integrate real SMS provider (SNS or Twilio)
Integrate SES for email notifications
Add retries, failure tracking, and delivery metrics

milestones.title: Production Promotion and Readiness
milestones.outcome: Safe gated production releases with rollback confidence

tasks.title: Set manual approval gate for production deployments
Promote tested staging artifact to production
Run go-live checklist and rollback drill
